title: Fix InvalidCastException in Enum patches and filter font warnings
body:
Fixes InvalidCastException in Enum patches (Patch_Enum_IsDefined, Patch_Enum_GetName, Patch_Enum_Parse) when value is a string, preventing save loading crashes. Also adds DebugFilterPatch to suppress missing underline character warnings for font assets and adds unit tests in WankulCrazyPlugin.Tests.
